column1: # How gate-tools.sh answers a call to one of the Alis MCP server's tools.
# One rule per line, three tab-separated columns:
#   pattern   an extended regular expression on the tool's own name (without
#             the mcp__plugin_alisx_alis__ prefix)
#   decision  allow  run without asking: it changes nothing
#             ask    always ask the person, in every permission mode
#             none   no answer: Claude Code's own permission handling applies
#   reason    shown to the person with an ask
# The first rule that matches decides. A tool no rule matches gets none.
# Whatever a rule says, a call whose arguments ask for production, a reveal or
# an override (confirm_production, reveal, approve, force) is asked about, and a
# call whose arguments carry a secret-looking value is refused.
# The server is growing to cover what the alis CLI does. Every tool it serves
# gets an explicit rule above the fallbacks; tests/release-guard.sh fails when
# one in tests/fixtures/mcp-tools.txt has none (scripts/sync-tools.sh refreshes
# that list from the server's source).
# Skills: reads.
^(search_skills|list_skills|preview_skill|load_skill|read_skill_file|list_skill_revisions)$
# Skills: writes the server marks destructive.
^update_skill$
column3: Publishes a new version of this skill to everyone who uses it.

column1: ^restore_skill_version$
column3: Publishes an earlier version as this skill's newest, for everyone who uses it.

column1: ^delete_skill$
column3: Deletes this skill for everyone it is shared with. This cannot be undone.

column1: # Skills: other writes.
^(create_skill|request_skill|send_skill_feedback)$
# Conversations: reads.
^(list_conversations|search_conversations|get_conversation|read_attachment|wait_for_reply)$
# Conversations: writes that people read.
^(start_conversation|send_message|resolve_conversation|reopen_conversation)$
# --- fallbacks: tools the server adds before this file names them ---
# Anything that removes, stops or changes what runs: ask.
(^|_)(delete|destroy|uninstall|unset|purge|revoke|cancel|rollback|deploy|release|promote)(_|$)
column3: Changes or removes something on the Alis Build platform.

column1: # Reads that may return secret values: ask.
(secret|credential|password|token|reveal)
column3: May return secret values into this conversation.

column1: # Other reads: allow.
^(get|list|search|describe|read|preview|view|wait|check)_
